meta.solver: LSODA (phonebatt.run, rtol 1e-7) for point predictions; phonebatt.run_batch RK4 for V1 UQ; local cell drivers (LSODA) for V2-V5

uq_settings.primary: uq_cal_fixed: P_awake held at the [CAL] default 0.090 W; every other §4 factor (UQ_SPEC) sampled with scrambled Sobol' (seed 2026); device capacity Q_dev*Q_n/4.70 and R·Q = const (A12)
uq_settings.abc: uq_abc: prior samples whose 14 Pro idle TTE is within ±5 % of the observed 55.03 h (§9 item 4)

calibration.note: 25 °C only: OCV = V + I·R_Σ on the C/20 curve; C_th, R_th fitted to the 2C temperature rise (validation.hg2_calibration).  All activation energies RP-63.

dynamic_UDDS.reason: no UDDS (or other drive-cycle) file in docs/research/data/validation/lg_hg2_raw: only the C/20, 0.5C and 2C discharges were extracted; downloading was out of scope

V2.solver: analysis/validation_cells.py (core cell functions, constant current, LSODA rtol 1e-7)

obs.note: observed TTE = load duration t_load_end_s (FINAL_SPEC §8 V3: 55.8 -> 39.7 min)

V3.note: B0005: R0 <- EIS R_e, R1 <- R_ct, Q_max <- integrated 2 A capacity (params.nasa_b0005); Ai2020 4.2 V OCV (U(0) = 3.018 V), V_cut 2.7 V, RP-63 activation energies, cell-only heat balance

calibration.kind: OCV = cubic in coulomb-counted z through the |I| < 0.02 A samples

V4.settings: cell temperature prescribed from the log; RK4 h = 0.25 s, zero-order hold of the 1 Hz current; primary = L2_cellRQ (R0·Q = 89.3 mΩ·Ah, R1·Q = 47 mΩ·Ah, τ1 = 30 s)

settings.note: ECM parameters are the research-step [RUN] 1RC/2RC fits to this DFN's 1C pulses at 25 and 0 °C (two-point Arrhenius); the 25/0 °C pulse comparisons are therefore near in-sample for R0/R1/tau1, the constant-power TTEs and all -10 °C cases are out-of-sample.  All ECMs isothermal like the DFN; same OCV (CRM06 fit of the Ai2020 OCV) and the same z window.  L2_rp63Ea uses RP-63 activation energies.

config.note: workload P̄ = E_u/159 min (LEE20 25 °C operating time, energy bucket): an input intensity, not a fitted model parameter
